results.name: MX-5 + synthetic raised wing: wing on

warnings: Forces were still drifting, so the run was extended by 5.0 flow passes. The average then settled.

Modelled as zero-thickness walls (thinner than about 1.5 cells, even with detail refinement): rear_wing_high, wing_high_endplate_left, wing_high_endplate_right, wing_high_support_left, wing_high_support_right. Their outline and angle are resolved; their thickness is not.

Wings and other aero parts: their drag change is close to OpenFOAM's, but their downforce is under-predicted (a third to two thirds of OpenFOAM's change in our checks), and similar wing angles can look alike. Compare variants on drag first and cross-check the final wing with the OpenFOAM version.
Enclosed air pockets inside the geometry were filled as solid.
